naturetools

Tools for calculating and plotting COSEWIC Index of Area of Occupancy (IAO) and Extent of Occurrence (EOO) ranges. Builds on the naturecounts package, which provides data access, example data and tutorials.

Installation 

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("BirdsCanada/naturetools")

Example 

library(naturetools)

r <- cosewic_ranges(naturecounts::bcch)
cosewic_plot(r)
